description: The state of the developer's payout account (Stripe Connect), needed to sell products inside their apps. One account per developer, or per project that has its own (projectId). "status": account none | pending | active | restricted, with chargesEnabled / payoutsEnabled, what is missing in words (missing: [{ key, words, overdue }], errors Stripe found, verifying, filledByNeblla), and `message`, a short status sentence in the developer's language. It asks Stripe every time. With no account it says why (lostAccount: the stored one is not on Neblla's Stripe, e.g. one opened in test mode). stripeReachable: false means Stripe did not answer (error.kind "down") or refused (error.message says why). Changes nothing; neblla_payments_account opens the onboarding and the dashboard.
name: neblla_payments_account_read
title: Payments account (read)
